description: Retention/lifecycle daemon that runs nightly to expire exemptions past their valid_until date. Reads mcp_exemptions table via write_service query endpoint. Marks expired exemptions by updating a status column or moving to a shadow table. Heartbeat to service_health every 60s. Pure Python daemon pattern: run() + if __name__ == '__main__': run(). No DB writes directly — all through write_service :8772. Dependencies: requests, datetime.
